name: Vex 2
summary:
Vex is back with bigger, larger and even harder levels. You can swim, slide, wall jump, use zip-lines, swing on poles, fire yourself out of cannons and even change the gravity to get through 11 of the best Vex stages yet!

Still not satisfied? We added in-game achievements to mix things up a bit. Let the inner 'completionist' escape.

Stage Builder also returns and even easier to use than before. With easy dragging mechanics its so simple to come up with a stage to send to a buddy.

Thank you for trying Vex 2, please leave any feedback below.
